body.summary: Completed the bounded one-company stress gauntlet. Four shared-object lanes crossed Powers, Frappe, Model/Provider, Format, Partner, Work, Evidence, and physical-fabric owners and converged on a reusable tamper-evident proof. All runnable checks passed; unavailable runtime edges were preserved as exact blockers. No external mutation, spend, model download, or partner effect occurred.
